name: python-scapegoat-tree
title: Scapegoat Tree
blurb: A binary search tree that rebuilds instead of rotating: the 0.7 alpha rule decides every repair, depth stays under log base 1/alpha of n, rebuilds are lossless against bisect, and the work counter settles at n log n.
default_description: A search tree whose repairs are whole-subtree rebuilds, with the alpha rule, the depth promise, and the amortized bill proved against bisect on mixed workloads.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a tipped subtree is flattened and rebuilt whole
